summary.text: Patrick Binder is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 20, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as businessman.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Binder graduated from University of San Diego High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of California, Irvine, in 2007.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a localist and gave his campaign's key messages as freedom, citizens and locals.
